item.title: NASA awards Texas Tech $5.4 million to fund heat-flow probe moon mission
item.description: Texas Tech University announced it was awarded $5.4 million to fund a third moon mission for Texas Tech geophysicist Seiichi Nagihara’s lunar heat-flow instrument, (LISTER).

item.title: Donley County Courthouse restoration project beginning soon
item.description: DONLEY COUNTY, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) — After 135 years, the Donley County Courthouse is undergoing restoration construction. item.title: Amarillo Police invite community to ceremonial swearing-in for new police chief
item.description: The Amarillo Police Department invites the community to a ceremonial swearing-in for its new police chief, Thomas Hover. The event is scheduled for 12:30 p.m. on Friday at the City Hall Council Chambers.
